name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan (GTL)
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance:** 1. The applicant can avail a term loan for viable income-generating schemes, including sanitation-related activities. 1. The maximum project cost covered under the scheme is ₹15,00,000/-. 1. The General Term Loan can be provided up to a maximum of 90% of the unit

_eligibility_text: 1. Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers) identified Manual Scavengers and their dependents. 1. Registered co-operative societies of Safai Karamcharis. 1. Legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target group, and 1. All those who produce a certificate from the local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/Railway Officer, Head of the Government. Departments (i.e. Schools, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted Officer, Elected Members of Municipal Body & Pradhan of Gram Panchayats, Regional Managers of Regional Rural Banks(RRBs)/Nationalised Banks. 1. However, under the MS Act, 2013, a person identified as a Manual Scavenger in a survey need not provide any certificate once his/her name appears in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State Governments/Union Territory Administration. ([https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/content/home/ms-survey-2018](https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/content/home/ms-survey-2018), [https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/node/79798](https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/node/79798)). 1. No income limit is fixed for availing financial assistance. However, other things being equal, NSKFDC accords priority to economic development and rehabilitation of – - Scavengers and amongst scavengers those scavengers whose income is below double the poverty line; - Women from among the target group and - Disabled persons among the target group.
